steps.body: A triangle has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. A hexagon has 6 straight sides and 6 corners. Those counts help name each shape.
steps.narration: A triangle has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. A hexagon has 6 straight sides and 6 corners. Those counts help name each shape.

widget.prompt: Tap the shape with exactly 3 straight sides.

hotspots.label: square
hotspots.feedback: A square has 4 straight sides — the 3-sided one is the triangle.

hotspots.label: circle
hotspots.feedback: A circle has no straight sides at all; it curves the whole way round.

hotspots.label: rectangle
hotspots.feedback: A rectangle has 4 straight sides — count again for the 3-sided shape.

widget.missFeedback: Count the straight sides on each shape, then tap the one with 3.
widget.successFeedback: Yes — 3 straight sides and 3 corners make a triangle.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g1s defining.
invariants: A shape's defining attributes must stay fixed while colour, size and orientation vary.
misconceptions: Treating colour, size or orientation as if it decided what a shape is.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same shape?

explanationVariants: Sides and corners define a shape.

widget.prompt: How many corners does a triangle have?

commonErrors.feedback: That counts one more corner than a triangle actually has; trace around it once and stop where you began.
That misses one corner; the last one closes the triangle back to the start.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Look again at the shape's sides and corners, counting each one exactly once.

steps.narration: Count the straight sides and corners of the pictured triangle and hexagon. Changing colour or size would not change those counts.

widget.prompt: Tap the shape with 4 equal straight sides and 4 square corners.

hotspots.label: triangle
hotspots.feedback: A triangle has only 3 straight sides. Look for 4 equal sides and 4 square corners.

hotspots.label: circle
hotspots.feedback: A circle has a curved edge, not 4 equal straight sides and 4 square corners.

hotspots.label: rectangle
hotspots.feedback: This rectangle has 4 square corners, but its 4 sides are not all equal. Tap the square.

widget.missFeedback: Check both rules: 4 equal straight sides and 4 square corners.
widget.successFeedback: Yes — all 4 sides are equal and all 4 corners are square.

widget.prompt: What makes a shape a square?

options.label: 4 equal sides and 4 square corners
options.feedback: Correct — a square has 4 equal straight sides and 4 square corners; colour, size, and direction can change.

options.label: Painted a bright red colour
options.feedback: Color can change freely without the shape changing; it is not a defining attribute.

options.label: Made much bigger in size
options.feedback: Size can change freely without the shape changing; a tiny square is still a square.

options.label: Turned to face a new direction
options.feedback: Turning a shape does not change what it is; orientation is not a defining attribute.
